original_requirement: Propagate the exact current local Draft validator rejection into the next existing same-scope Draft retry, without changing validator meaning, authority approval, retry topology, route, model, output budget, or any downstream business boundary.
operational_definition: After an existing Draft attempt is rejected specifically as reject_unapproved_mixed_script, Runtime binds the exact current token to its hash-only validator decision, renders a bounded untrusted DraftRetryFindingV1 block into only the next already-permitted retry, and recomputes the block from the next Draft before any later retry.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not turn a rejected token into an approved token or alter the R1-D1 authority projection.
Do not increase retry, fallback, call, elapsed, or output-token budgets.
Do not change the first Draft request, Provider adapter, Gateway, Route, model alias, parser, semantic review, Final Review, Maintenance, StoryState, Canon, or Phase 1B.
Do not persist Draft text, Prompt text, raw Provider responses, credentials, or headers as evidence.
Do not claim the whole-scope retry drift risk is fixed by this narrow propagation change.
closed_world_justification: The only actionable source is the finite mixed_script_decisions list emitted by the unchanged local validator for the current in-memory Draft; only decision=reject_unapproved_mixed_script is eligible, and its token must be recovered by exact SHA-256 binding through the same authoritative tokenizer.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Structured, deterministic, bounded, injection-safe current finding
constraint_traceability.implementation: DraftRetryFindingV1, build_draft_retry_findings, and render_actionable_draft_validation_findings use exact token/hash binding, canonical UTF-8 JSON, deterministic sort/dedupe, hard count/length/size bounds, and explicit untrusted-data markers.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Tests cover identity, reason, authority status, dedupe, ordering, count/size bounds, control characters, quoted scope data, and canonical serialization.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Initial Draft Prompt and retry topology remain unchanged
constraint_traceability.implementation: WorkflowService._draft_short_segment_task appends the new block only when retry_findings is non-empty; retry_same_scope retains retry_count >= 2 and recursively uses the same role, route selection, max-output calculation, contract, and scope.
constraint_traceability.evidence: The sanitized initial Prompt remains 24ff78bd..., fake calls retain the same primary Draft model and max-output value, ignore-finding still terminates after two retries, and the 13K/20K/30K production-length matrix passes.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Current finding reaches the retry and stale findings never accumulate
constraint_traceability.implementation: The local validator decisions are converted immediately after each current Draft; retry_same_scope passes that immutable tuple to exactly the recursive retry request, whose next result is validated and converted anew.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Production-shaped fake cases prove convergence, unchanged terminal behavior when ignored, AlphaTerm-to-BetaTerm refresh without stale AlphaTerm, and approved SignalKey bypassing the finding path.

constraint_traceability.requirement: R1-D1 validator and hash-only evidence remain unchanged
constraint_traceability.implementation: prose_quality.py has no diff; the existing mixed_script_decisions are consumed but not altered, and the existing validation receipt persists token hashes and counts only.
constraint_traceability.evidence: The exact R1-D1 production file SHA-256 remains b5647536..., approved/unapproved/corruption/stale cases retain their prior decisions, and raw rejected terms are absent from validation receipts.
